friction_events.description: Two primary-chat canaries resolved PONG but could not safely append to the large canonical mirror because the connected GitHub writer replaces the whole file while retrieved bytes were transport-truncated.
Representative JavaScript browser verification could not run because this runtime exposes no invocable JS/DOM browser; HTTP retrieval was not substituted.
Recent returns contained duplicate mirror-append boundaries and already-owned capability/authority blockers; Guide Integrator collapsed them instead of spawning duplicate work.
The public exit-audit URL cache-missed; the byte-equivalent published gh-pages source was read directly and the audit continued without changing authority.

decision_trace.decision: Create and freeze a fresh v3.30 identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Human launch required NUEVO_WORKER=1 and first durable beacon.
decision_trace.action: Created the fresh beacon and reused the same worker_id/launch_nonce for the resident chain.
decision_trace.outcome: Fresh identity was durable before any claim.

decision_trace.decision: Do not destructively rewrite the large chat mirror from partial bytes.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Writer was replace-whole-file and source transport was truncated; range reads did not provide an atomic append primitive.
decision_trace.action: Persisted truthful BOUNDARY returns and continued unrelated resident work.
decision_trace.outcome: Existing mirror history was preserved; duplicate boundary was later deduped.

decision_trace.decision: Treat representative-browser absence as a capability boundary rather than a PASS.
decision_trace.observable_basis: No invocable JavaScript/DOM browser was available in the runtime.
decision_trace.action: Persisted BOUNDARY and did not substitute HTTP retrieval.
decision_trace.outcome: No false served-browser verification was created.

decision_trace.decision: Resolve STT source/auth/deploy debt without sending private audio or mutating Supabase.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Recent STT preflights exposed missing deploy ownership and private-audio request identity; connected Supabase reads exposed live Served metadata/source.
decision_trace.action: Recovered the Served request contract, established a gated deploy-owner contract, and persisted a Served-vs-candidate delta review.
decision_trace.outcome: STT has grounded contracts/evidence while deployment and private-audio E2E remain separately gated.

decision_trace.decision: Continue after target 6 to the pool hard cap because compatible product work remained.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Binding pool residency rule says target 6 is not terminal while compatible product/assist work remains, up to cap 8.
decision_trace.action: Completed a second STT Planner unit and the Served-source delta review.
decision_trace.outcome: Resident chain reached 8/8 productive units and then entered E9.

top_time_sinks.note: Safe append/patch unavailable for the large canonical chat mirror.
Representative JavaScript browser capability absent for served-browser checks.
Bounded STT archaeology/live readback was needed to separate Candidate source, Served identity and deployment authority.

unfinished_debt.item: Primary-chat mirror still needs a safe atomic patch/append or byte-complete conditional-update writer.
Representative-browser verification remains pending in a runtime with a genuine JavaScript/DOM browser.
Authenticated private-audio E2E still requires a bounded ephemeral sample and valid room credentials kept outside durable evidence.
Any future study-transcribe-v1 deployment requires explicit Supabase mutation authority.
The STT private-audio receipt privacy guard is materialized but unexecuted.
The Alumnos six-route static review handoff is materialized but unexecuted.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Expose an atomic append/patch or byte-complete conditional file-update primitive for large GitHub files.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Removes repeated chat-mirror transport boundaries without destructive full-file reconstruction.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Compile known representative-browser capability absence/repeated boundary markers into allocation so incompatible recoveries are suppressed for this runtime class.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduces useless claim/recovery cycles and false browser expectations.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Make external mutation authority requirements first-class candidate metadata distinct from repository write authority.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Lets workers reject/route deploy tasks before expensive context loading while preserving human authority boundaries.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 PROD-01 worker reached the resident hard cap with 8 durable productive units across Alumnos, STT and integration work. It created grounded successors/contracts, recovered live STT request identity read-only, preserved browser/transport/Supabase authority boundaries, sent no private audio, performed no Supabase deployment and made no Served/Current/Human Accepted promotion.
